description:
Winchcombe Museum occupies the historic Old Town Hall in the centre of the town. It began in 1928 with a collection of documents gathered by Eleanor Adlard.

The museum explores Winchcombe and its surrounding area through local objects and historical material. A small police collection recalls its earlier shared use of the building with the Ross Simms collection.

description:
Wisbech and Fenland Museum preserves the natural and cultural heritage of Wisbech and the surrounding Fenland. Its collections connect the history of the market town and port with rural life.

Fine and decorative art, Egyptian objects, photography and local historical material are represented. Documents and objects associated with Thomas Clarkson illuminate his campaign against the transatlantic slave trade.

description:
Wollongong Art Gallery preserves a municipal collection shaped by local support and the artistic life of the Illawarra. The gallery opened in 1978.

First Nations art, Australian art from the colonial period to modernism, and contemporary Australian practice are its main collecting areas. Works connected with Dharawal Country and the South Coast give the collection a strong regional focus.

description:
Yaroslavl Art Museum combines an art collection with historic architectural settings. Its main displays occupy the former Governor’s House in Yaroslavl.
